finding: The scope leaves transition cardinality open without explicitly distinguishing per-action occurrence cardinality from the already fixed one-successor property of each successfully realized T. The cited sources settle the latter; it is not a future choice.
severity: documentary precision with material preservation consequence; not a new normative gap
text: Per-action transition necessity and occurrence cardinality remain unresolved. For each identified T, successful realization derives exactly one valid successor from its valid source state under the published mapping and satisfied preconditions. Failure preserves the original state and creates no partial, repaired or alternate successor. The exact source-defined relation signature remains unfixed; BOOL3 output alone does not prove this single-successor property.

finding: The exclusion “byte/digest equality as semantic EQ” is overbroad if read literally. The governing expression language admits equal on complete canonical typed encodings. What is forbidden is substituting equality for source-owned semantic definitions, not every justified use of equal.
severity: documentary correction; prevents accidental strengthening of published rules
basis: S70 E266-SEM-TYPES (equal semantics and closed definition records), E266-SEM-COMMITMENT (commitment equality neither required nor sufficient), E266-SEM-COMPARISON
text: Excluded discretion: treating byte, digest or commitment equality as semantic EQ without the governing source-owned definition and independent materiality/coverage support. The admitted equal operator may be used within a source-owned typed predicate where its semantic adequacy is established. No predicate is selected by this correction; commitment equality alone remains neither necessary nor sufficient for semantic equivalence.

finding: Cross-slot references to admission evidence and all required evidence can conflate documentary drafting, static profile admission and occurrence validation. The source separates these stages and forbids occurrence evidence inside the immutable profile. Future actual occurrences cannot be required to finish the present brief.
severity: documentary phase clarification; no admission requirement removed
basis: S70 E266-SEM-PRIVACY (static admission versus occurrence evidence; no occurrence evidence inside profile); E266-SEM-DEPENDENCY; S69 registry admission before insertion; S55 §§13,18–19
text: Documentary drafts may identify unresolved definitions and unavailable evidence without claiming admission. Static profile admission requires complete immutable definitions, independent ownership/minimality/coverage support, actual trusted privacy appointment and complete static component/composition evidence. Real D/U/Q0, current values, openings, per-U history, successful occurrence packages and fresh recovery sufficiency are required at their corresponding occurrence validation/use boundaries, not as invented prerequisites to draft the scope. Required source definitions of those facts must close before admission. Later governed acts retain their separate prerequisites and authorizations.
